title: Mung Bean and Millet Patties
subtitle: with basil and green chilli schug pesto
description: Vegan patties made from soaked mung beans, millet and potato, fried until golden and served with a basil and olive oil schug-style pesto.

steps.text: Soak the mung beans in water for 12 hours and drain.
Bring the millet to the boil with 1 cup of water and a little salt. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 15-20 minutes over low heat until it becomes a sticky porridge. Set aside.

Place the mung beans, millet, boiled potatoes, onion, parsley leaves, 1 clove of garlic, baharat, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper in a food processor and pulse until uniform. If too wet, add another 1-2 tablespoons of breadcrumbs. Cover and chill for 1 hour.
Heat oil in a large heavy non-stick pan. Shape the mixture into ping pong ball-sized balls and flatten slightly. Fry in batches for 3-4 minutes each side and drain on paper towel.
For the pesto, process the basil, seeded green chillies and 1 clove of garlic while drizzling in the olive oil. Scrape down the sides and blend to a paste. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the patties with the pesto. Store leftover pesto in a jar covered with olive oil in the fridge for up to a week.
